payload.text: ST0091/04, the workflows fire on the candidate and the docs describe the cut as built, dc's; vc judges it and claims nothing. Started and claimed on vc's C4 ruling (decision 112). Its trigger part is banked as the train's first unit at refs/bank/dc/st0091/wp04-trigger-v1 (blob ee3409fcdced, patch-id 2c4e9bc3ab35, base 991e92946), held staged in tmp/wt-dc-0091. tests.yml and linux-release.yml fire on candidate/** and not on tags; tests.yml calls rust.yml for a candidate or a dispatch, so its verdict is inside the one run the cut reads, and test-summary fails a candidate on which the macOS or rust leg was skipped. AT-04.1 cites tests/unit/release_candidate_trigger.bats and stays to-write until the train lands, since `intent at red` refuses a row whose cited file is not on main; each red driven against its three tests is the base's own line restored. vc judges the bank with the train in one run on its tip, and vc puts one dispatch of tests.yml on main, after the push, to hv as a precondition of the cut. The docs part (AC-04.2) follows the rest of the train, and AC-04.3 is hv's first cut through the core.
